title: finding(app-shell): the Studio screen preview and the Debug run's screen pause gate `visibleWhen` with the legacy `ExpressionEvaluator`, which fails open — the runtime evaluates it as CEL and hides the field
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites (class a). A designer preview shows a field the runtime hides. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the objectui#10615 dev report (PR objectui#10672, finding 3) and the contract review of that PR at `7f49154`, which confirmed it and widened its reach. The dev measured it; ⛔ the seat did not re-run it. It is pre-existing. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Measurement (the dev's probe; ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

`isFieldVisibleWhen` in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/screen-spec.ts` goes through `evalCondition` (`flow-sim-validate.ts`), which uses `@object-ui/core`'s legacy `ExpressionEvaluator`:
- a `visibleWhen` of `size(tags)` greater than 0 with `tags = []`: the legacy evaluator errors and the gate fails OPEN, so the field is visible;
- `'vars.n == 2'` with `n = 3`: visible.

The runtime's `refuseInvalidScreenInput` evaluates `visibleWhen` with `evaluateCondition` (CEL), gets `false`, and hides the field.

## Reach (the review's reading)

- the Studio screen preview;
- the Debug run's own screen pause: `FlowSimulatorPanel` renders `ScreenPreview` with the run's variables. So after PR objectui#10672, a second evaluator is still left inside the Debug run, off the edge-guard path.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Route `isFieldVisibleWhen` through the same `ExpressionEngine.evaluate({ dialect: 'cel', … }, flowCelScope(…))` call `evalGuard` uses (PR objectui#10672). Decide what a faulting `visibleWhen` does, instead of failing open. Once `evalCondition` has no importer, retire it. Pin both measured cases against the runtime's answer. ⛔ Serial: PR objectui#10672 edits `flow-sim-validate.ts` and `screen-spec.ts`; claim this after it merges.

## Dedupe

REST read of every objectui issue and PR updated since 2026-09-24T00:00Z (777 items), with titles matched against `visibleWhen|screen preview|isFieldVisibleWhen`: only objectui#8070 (clear-on-hide, closed) and objectui#10598, neither about the evaluator. The regex walk over the 1000 most recently updated items, `isFieldVisibleWhen|visibleWhen.*screen`, found 0 about this.

Dedupe words: `isFieldVisibleWhen legacy evaluator` · `screen preview visibleWhen CEL` · `Debug run screen pause visibleWhen fails open`
